responsibility: Holds shared vector expanders and utility patterns that sit between the generic rs6000 machine description and the specialized Altivec/VSX/SPE/paired instruction files. It defines common mode iterators, generic vector move/load/store and reduction expanders, little-endian VSX move handling, multireg splits, vector shift/rotate helpers, and the generic V2SF expanders shared by SPE and paired-float targets, while leaving most concrete instruction selection to altivec.md, vsx.md, spe.md, and paired.md.
